bonus_cashback_games_text12: You can only receive bonus funds in the Promo Code Store if you have activated the "Bonus Points for Placed Bets" offer in My Account. The "Bonus on Your Account Balance" cannot be activated at the same time.

bonus_cashback_games_text8: Bonus funds are collected for your daily activity and credited by clicking the Promo Points Request button in the Promo Code Store, provided that you have collected at least {0} promo points.
bonus_cashback_games_text9: Your activities from the last 10 days, or since the last time you were credited with bonus funds, will be taken into account.
